entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: An elf-faerie hybrid created by Oona as a duplicate bearing her memories, who defies and destroys Oona and becomes queen of the fae of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Original Maralen of the Mornsong
entities.description: The real Mornsong elf killed by Oona while picking moonglove and replaced by a faerie duplicate.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The queen of the fae who ruled Lorwyn-Shadowmoor through the Great Aurora and created Maralen and Oko; destroyed by Maralen.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A shapeshifter fae created by Oona, Maralen's brother, who flees, returns decades later and erodes her mind.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf hunter who travels with Maralen and is bound by pact to poison her if Oona returns.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin pilgrim whose ritual on Mount Tanufel Maralen exploits.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: Three faerie siblings who spy for Oona and later attend Maralen.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: The ancient last yew and Rhys's former mentor who dies in fire, leaving a sapling.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: A sleeping giant whose sleep-talk prophecies reveal the future of the plane.

entities.name: Jack Chierdagh
entities.description: A kithkin whom Maralen helps divert the giant from Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: The one from whom Maralen takes the Crescent of Morningtide.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf perfect who pursues Isilu with distilled dawnglove.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The celestial incarnation of Lorwyn's day, sequestered in Maralen's palace grounds.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The celestial incarnation of Shadowmoor's night, displaced and pursued by Morcant.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: A dual-plane whose day and night were controlled by Oona through the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The faerie haven that Maralen rules from, which evolves to blur light and shadow.

entities.name: The Great Aurora
entities.description: The shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor that Oona controlled.

entities.name: Moonglove
entities.description: An exquisitely rare and poisonous flower found only in Lorwyn, kept by Rhys to poison Maralen if Oona returns.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: The elvish court of Lys Alana, whose forces attack Maralen's party.

events.summary: Oona creates a pair of fae from a petal of her body to carry her memories into the coming world; the first, Oko, is deemed a failure and flees.
events.quote: As a contingency, Oona took a petal from her floral body and used it to create a pair of fae that could each carry her memories forward into the coming world.

events.summary: Oona deploys the second heir, who will become Maralen, into Lorwyn as the Great Aurora nears.
events.quote: As the Great Aroura neared, Oona deployed this second heir into Lorwyn.

events.summary: In 4520 AR faeries slaughter a Mornsong wedding convoy.
events.quote: In 4520 AR , a group of faeries descended on a Mornsong wedding convoy and slaughtered them all.

events.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen as she picks moonglove and replaces her with a faerie duplicate.
events.quote: An elf named Maralen was singled out and killed by Oona as she unsuspectingly picked moonglove .

events.summary: Maralen meets Rhys in the Porringer Valley after his poison magic devastated the forest, and he agrees to take her toward Lys Alana.
events.quote: Nonetheless, he agreed to take her to the Gilt-Leaf capital, Lys Alana .

events.summary: The Vendilion clique takes Maralen directly to Oona after failing to read her mind.
events.quote: took her then directly to Oona

events.summary: After her audience with Oona, Maralen conjures fae magic to vanish Gilt-Leaf troops and watches Colfenor die and his sapling be born.
events.quote: She then went on to observe the fiery death of Colfenor and the subsequent birth of his sapling

events.summary: Maralen comes to understand she is a fae duplicate created by Oona to carry her essence into Shadowmoor.
events.quote: She was a fae duplicate created by Oona to bear her memories and essence into the coming darkness of Shadowmoor

events.summary: Sharing Rosheen's dreamscape, Maralen decides to defy Oona.
events.quote: Maralen awoke, freshly determined to defy the queen and greet the uncertain new world to do so.

events.summary: Maralen manipulates Endry into planting a faerie ring on the sapling to siphon the power of Ashling's ritual.
events.quote: She had manipulated Endry into planting a faerie ring of mushrooms on the sapling

events.summary: Maralen obtains Rosheen's scroll after helping Jack Chierdagh divert a giant from Mistmeadow.
events.quote: The first, a scroll belonging to Rosheen, came into her possession after she and the siblings helped Jack Chierdagh divert the giant

events.summary: Maralen is revealed to be a twin of Oona, defies her, and takes the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli.
events.quote: Later, she took the Crescent of Morningtide from Brigid Baeli and challenged Oona to face her in a direct fight.

events.summary: Maralen, with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals, destroys Oona and becomes queen of the fae.
events.quote: Oona was destroyed and wiped from the face of Lorwyn.

events.summary: Maralen gives Rhys the moonglove and instructs him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return.
events.quote: Maralen gave the moonglove to Rhys and instructed him to poison her at the first sign of Oona's return

events.summary: Rhys is granted eternal life until he can fulfill his oath.
events.quote: Rhys was granted eternal life until he was able to carry out his oath-sworn duty.

events.summary: Maralen sequesters Eirdu within her palace grounds, fearing Oona's return.
events.quote: As her fears of Oona's influence began to consume her, Maralen had come to sequester Eirdu within her palace grounds.

events.summary: Forty years into her reign Oko returns and exploits Maralen's paranoia, betraying her fears to Rhys.
events.quote: but Oko betrayed her secret fears to Rhys

events.summary: In Goldmeadow, Rhys cuts Maralen with moonglove poison, thinking he was freeing her from Oona.
events.quote: he sliced her with the moonglove poison, thinking he was freeing his old friend from Oona's clutches

events.summary: Oko recognized as her brother, uses Morcant's dawnglove extract to counteract the poison and save Maralen.
events.quote: He used the vial of distilled dawnglove extract that Morcant carried and used it to counteract the poison of the moonglove.

events.summary: Isilu is joined by Eirdu and departs, restoring balance to the plane.
events.quote: Balance had been restored to the plane, and Maralen and Oko reconciled.

events.summary: Rhys is freed from his binding promise and dissolves into petals as Maralen embraces her brother.
events.quote: Maralen watched sorrowfully as Rhys dissolved into a flurry of moonglove and dawnglove petals.

relations.note: created her from a petal as a successor and memory-bearer

relations.note: Maralen's older sibling, created from the other half of the petal
relations.quote: The first, a shapeshifter named Oko , destined to lead Shadowmoor and who got into furious fights with Oona as he grew up, was deemed a failure and fled.
Oko, whom Maralen finally recognized as her brother after seeing him in his true, envisaged Shadowmoor form, held her as she died and resolved to save her.
Oona was destroyed and wiped from the face of Lorwyn.
